summary: Frontend-only test of the per-programme journey card, streak card and daily check-in for 6 demo students (stu-ananya, mm-diya, me-riya, fe-aarav, fe-meher, fe-vihaan), plus regression checks. Everything requested works. Each programme shows its own journey title, grade chip and focus line, today prompt, mood labels, stage captions, phase names, next-up label, quote, streak title, phase bar and badge names. The journey summary, stage, next-stage count and streak stage all matched the report API data (logged_days, ticks, stage = 1 + floor(ticks/5)). Past-day activity chips matched the ticks exactly. Future days are locked. Check-ins: stu-ananya answered 'Not this time' to all → stage stayed at 5 and the toast read 'Saved to your plan'. mm-diya answered 1 Yes → went from 19 to 20 activities and Stage 4 to Stage 5, with the toast 'New stage unlocked: Positive Prep'. Both results persisted after reload. Found only minor copy and design issues.

issues: Mood buttons are hard-coded to Struggling/Rough/Mixed/Steady/Strong and the heading 'How are you feeling today?' is the same for every programme. The journey card on the same screen shows programme-specific labels (e.g. FocusEdge Tough/Wobbly/Okay/Good/Great, MindMellow Pressured/.../Ready), so the two use different words for the same 0-4 value. Consider using journeyCopy(programme).moodShort and .ask in the dialog. The 'Good to see you again!' / leaf decor wording is also shared.

For MindMellow, MindEdge and FocusEdge, the earned-badge tooltip shows the caption twice: line 2 is the caption and line 3 is '<caption> — you earned this, one step at a time.' Example: 'Calm Start / A little calmer today / A little calmer today — you earned this…'. The same repeated text appears in the stage-unlocked toast description. Give each programme its own short messages, or drop the caption line.

Phase 4 spans only 2 columns, so longer programme names are cut off, e.g. MindMellow shows 'Phase 4 · Ready ...' (Ready & Resilient). 'Focused & Confident' (FocusEdge) and 'Confident Captain' (MindEdge) likely get cut off too. The full name is only in the title attribute.

design_issues.screen: Journey card header on mobile 390px (completed journey: me-riya, fe-vihaan)
issues: The 'Journey complete' badge is whitespace-nowrap and sits beside the title block. This squeezes the title, grade chip, focus line and summary into a narrow column that wraps over 4–5 lines. Stack the badge under the title on small screens.

action_items: LOW: Use programme copy (moodShort and ask) in the DailyLog mood step so its labels match the journey card.
LOW: Remove the repeated caption from the non-EquiMind badge tooltip and stage-unlocked toast message.
LOW: Stop Phase 4 labels being cut off in the streak phase bar (shorter 'short' names or allow wrapping).
LOW: On mobile, put the journey-day-badge below the title.
critical_code_review_comments: journeyCopy.js mutates EQ/MM/ME/FE after the objects are created (EQ.ask = ... etc. on line 116-118). It works because the spread copies were taken before these assignments, but it is fragile. Put ask, grade and focusLine inside each object.
The EquiMind mood chip labels on the journey card ('Struggling/Rough day/Settling/Calmer/More Open') also differ from the DailyLog dialog labels. This is the same inconsistency as above.
StudentHome.save fires the stage-unlocked toast only after the PATCH succeeds, which is correct. The optimistic setLatest is not rolled back if the PATCH fails.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested checks passed (4 minor design/copy issues)

seed_data_creation: No new records. Expected data changes from the requested check-ins: stu-ananya Day 9 (index 8) logged with mood 2 and no ticks. mm-diya Day 9 logged with mood 2 and 1 tick (activity 0, 'Wake'), now Stage 5 with 20 activities. Feedback was skipped for both.

Report pages for fe-aarav and me-riya load with no broken images; the Biglyp home loads; no horizontal overflow on mobile.
